posts.title: New Year! Sans job
posts.description: It's been a bit since I've posted here but the last six months or so have been wildly busy and a bit of a tipping point in my life. This past week, I got laid off finally after wondering for basically my entire career thus far when it would happen. posts.title: Summer is here (why are my posts so seasonal?) (general stream-of-consciousness)
posts.description: I'm in DC for Pride weekend just for a change of pace. The first of many trips planned for this year. Time is really flying by and I'm glad it's no longer winter. My posts on this blog are so weirdly tied to the seasons.
